usage: The word '豬扒' (zyu1 paa4) is a noun and refers to a specific cut of pork, known as pork chop.
You can use '豬扒' to talk about ordering food at a restaurant or cooking pork chop dishes at home.
'豬扒' can be combined with different cooking methods, like '煎豬扒' (pan-fried pork chop) or '炸豬扒' (deep-fried pork chop).
When describing a meal, '豬扒' can function as the main ingredient or dish name.
Be careful not to confuse '豬扒' with '牛扒' (beef steak) or other types of meat cuts.
